rule.description: One named interface unions three or more unrelated sanitization-policy capability families (running a policy, declaring elements, attributes, styles, URL policies, hardening links and embedded content, and output toggles), so consumers must depend on capabilities they never use and implementors must carry the ones they do not provide.

checks.description: A named interface whose declared method set unions three or more unrelated policy-definer capability families, forcing every consumer and implementor of the seam to carry all of them.
checks.detected_relation: interface declaration -> multiple unrelated capability families
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A seam that spans independent maintenance capabilities cannot be consumed or implemented as a whole; every user is forced into the union whether or not it needs the other families.

matches.evidence: PolicyDefiner declares 28 methods covering all 7 capability families: 4 execution methods (Sanitize, SanitizeBytes, SanitizeReader, SanitizeReaderToWriter), 4 element declarations, 2 attribute declarations, 1 style declaration, 6 URL policies, 7 link and iframe hardening rules, and 4 output toggles.

checks.description: A function that receives the broad seam as a parameter but exercises only a slice of its capability families, depending on declarations it never makes and duties its role does not include.
checks.detected_relation: consumer function -> broad seam parameter with at least 2 unused capability families
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The function is bound to capabilities that have nothing to do with its production role; its signature, not its body, carries the coupling, and any change to the unrelated capabilities propagates to it.

matches.evidence: Declares standard URL rules (parseable URLs, relative URLs, common schemes, nofollow hardening: 2 families) through a seam that also requires execution, element, attribute, style and output capabilities.
Declares the global dir, lang, id and title attributes through the universal seam while ignoring all URL, hardening, element, style, execution and output capabilities.
Declares only the global class attribute through the universal seam.
Declares img attributes through the universal seam while delegating URL policy by passing the same broad parameter on to declareStandardURLs.
Uses only the parseable-URL and data-scheme custom policy methods of the universal seam.
Declares list elements and their type and value attributes through the universal seam.
Declares table structure and the 20+ table attributes through the universal seam while ignoring the rest of the definer surface.
Declares the iframe sandbox attribute and required sandbox values through the universal seam.

The email tool rule block declares document structure elements, styling attributes and link hardening (3 families) through the same universal seam that also requires execution, URL policy, style and output capabilities.
A stdin-to-stdout streaming runner that only sanitizes a document string, but is handed the full policy-defining seam rather than just the run capability it uses.
A stdin-to-stdout streaming runner that only sanitizes a document string, but is handed the full policy-defining seam rather than just the run capability it uses.

checks.description: A named type that implements the broad seam by discarding, with trivial bodies, the capabilities it does not actually provide - empty method bodies, lone returns of the underlying policy, or inert builder returns.
checks.detected_relation: implementor type -> broad seam with trivial-bodied discard stubs
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: To conform to a seam wider than its responsibility, the type must define a method for every unrelated capability; capabilities its role does not support are satisfied with do-nothing bodies that silently drop declarations.

matches.evidence: Implements all 28 seam methods of PolicyDefiner: forwards the 7 capabilities the UGC profile actually supports (plus the 4 run methods), while 18 methods discard their declarations with trivial bodies - returning the policy unchanged (regex elements, element content handling, all URL customizations, referrer and cross-origin hardening, unsafe parsing, strip spacing), returning inert builders (optional attributes, styles), or doing nothing (iframe sandbox, comments, data attributes).

excluded.reason: Interface with two methods of a single write capability; it does not union unrelated capability families and is execution machinery rather than the policy declaration seam.
Inline style sanitization inside the token loop; holds no policy declaration or run capability, so no capability-family union exists there.
Fluent chain-step builder types; their method sets are fixed by the exported chain API (Matching, OnElements, Globally) and are not part of the definer seam.

The concrete policy implements the seam with real bodies for all 28 methods - it declares and runs actual rules, so it is not a discard stub implementor; its inclusion as a seam implementor is the design working as intended for the concrete owner.
